_readme: Sample ComfyUI API-format workflow for Article2Pod using Breeze TTS 2 (local). Copy it to workflow-api.json to use Breeze: Article2Pod picks the TTS engine from the nodes in that file. Needs the ComfyUI-Breeze-TTS-2 nodes (https://github.com/saganaki22/ComfyUI-Breeze-TTS-2) and the int8 hybrid model in ComfyUI/models/breezetts2/ (downloaded on first use). Article2Pod fills in the text, voice sample, its transcript, the voice direction, guidance, temperature and seed for every segment, so the values below are only placeholders. Speed/precision settings (model, attention, decode_mode) are yours to change: decode_mode cuda_graphs gives the same audio as eager about 2.8x faster on an RTX 4070 Super (use eager if your GPU or driver has trouble with it); bf16 with sageattention is faster still but sounds slightly different and needs about 10 GB VRAM. The workflow needs one LoadAudio node, one BreezeTTS2VoiceDirection node and one SaveAudio node.

inputs.reference_text: Filled in by Article2Pod (the voice sample's transcript).
inputs.instruction: Filled in by Article2Pod (the voice direction for this segment).
